requirement: Build a production RAG service that ingests PDF manuals, chunks and embeds them into a vector database, and exposes a FastAPI endpoint that answers questions with citations back to the source page. Use pypdf for extraction, LangChain for the retrieval chain and Pydantic models for request and response validation. Include streaming responses and health checks. Use pinecone-client for the vector database.

libraries.name: langchain
libraries.reason: builds retrieval chain and handles LLM calls

libraries.name: pinecone-client
libraries.reason: stores and queries embedded document vectors

libraries.name: uvicorn
libraries.reason: runs the FastAPI app in production

doc_sources.title: FastAPI Documentation
doc_sources.rationale: The official FastAPI documentation site (fastapi.tiangolo.com) is the primary entry point maintained by the framework's author, matching the highest priority criteria. It is current, comprehensive, and directly linked in the search results.

doc_sources.title: pypdf Documentation
doc_sources.rationale: The Read the Docs site is the official documentation host for the pypdf library and serves as the root landing page for all versions. It is the primary entry point for users seeking API reference, tutorials, and guides. The GitHub repository is a fallback, but the docs site is preferred.

doc_sources.title: LangChain Documentation
doc_sources.rationale: The docs.langchain.com domain is the official documentation site for LangChain, matching the preferred first-party docs source. It is the root landing page for the current version of the library.

doc_sources.title: Pydantic Documentation
doc_sources.rationale: The official documentation site (pydantic.dev/docs/) is the primary entry point for the library, providing the latest version's landing page. It is directly from the maintainers, making it the most reliable source.

doc_sources.title: Pinecone Python SDK Overview
doc_sources.rationale: The URL is on the official Pinecone documentation site and points to the Python SDK reference, which is the primary entry point for the library's docs. This matches the preferred source hierarchy (own docs site > API reference).

doc_sources.title: Uvicorn – Fast ASGI server
doc_sources.rationale: The uvicorn.dev site is the library's own documentation homepage, providing the full reference and quickstart. It is the primary official docs site, making it the best entry point.
